title: Issue #5577 — string connect() error vs Callable form

blocks.text:
The Step by Step tutorial used a deprecated syntax for connecting signals.
This code does not work in Godot 4 and produces:
Invalid argument for "connect()" function: argument 2 should be Callable
but is res://Sprite2D.gd.
Invalid argument for "connect()" function: argument 3 should be Array but
is String.
The correct Class Reference form is timer.timeout.connect(_on_Timer_timeout).
